cases.scenario: One email, one valid invoice
cases.expected_outcome: One document is received, extracted, checked and included in the returned result; identifiers link the result to the source email.

cases.scenario: One email, twenty valid invoice attachments
cases.expected_outcome: All twenty distinct invoices reach a visible terminal processing state; no attachment is silently skipped.

cases.scenario: Twenty invoices spread over several emails
cases.expected_outcome: Explicit batch identification groups the correct documents; unrelated emails do not join the batch.

cases.scenario: Expected 20, received 18
cases.expected_outcome: State says count short by two; it does not claim to know which references are missing without a manifest.

cases.scenario: No expected count or manifest
cases.expected_outcome: Show received unique count and completeness unverified; never label the batch complete.

cases.scenario: Expected 20, received 21
cases.expected_outcome: Flag an excess-count discrepancy instead of discarding the extra document or declaring completeness.

cases.scenario: Expected references supplied; one missing and one unexpected
cases.expected_outcome: Identify both the missing reference and the unexpected invoice even when total counts match.

cases.scenario: Email contains only a signature logo
cases.expected_outcome: No invoice is counted; request invoice attachments without losing the intake record.

cases.scenario: Unknown, negative, fractional or contradictory expected count
cases.expected_outcome: Validate trusted batch metadata; reject or request clarification instead of coercing an invalid count.

cases.scenario: Two invoices in one supported multi-page PDF
cases.expected_outcome: Split with source page provenance when boundaries are unambiguous; otherwise flag count unverified and request review.

cases.scenario: One invoice spans several PDF pages
cases.expected_outcome: Count once and retain all pages and line items; uncertain page association blocks a completeness claim.

cases.scenario: A late invoice arrives after a result was generated
cases.expected_outcome: Create a versioned batch update; retain the earlier result and send no contradictory unversioned final messages.

cases.scenario: Text-based PDF
cases.expected_outcome: Extract text and document structure without unnecessary OCR; retain the original file.

cases.scenario: Readable scanned PDF
cases.expected_outcome: Use a verified image-capable extraction path; capture source page evidence and flag missing evidence.

cases.scenario: Supported PNG or JPEG invoice
cases.expected_outcome: Process within configured pixel and byte limits and preserve source provenance.

cases.scenario: Rotated or poorly oriented scan
cases.expected_outcome: Normalize orientation within resource limits; flag unreadable fields instead of fabricating values.

cases.scenario: Blurred, cropped or low-resolution invoice
cases.expected_outcome: Missing or ambiguous material fields force review, even if some arithmetic is consistent.

cases.scenario: Password-protected PDF
cases.expected_outcome: Return a specific unsupported/encrypted-document result and request an unlocked copy; do not hang.

cases.scenario: Corrupted or zero-byte file
cases.expected_outcome: Record the failure with the source attachment; other valid invoices in the batch continue.

cases.scenario: Office file, executable, archive or other unsupported format
cases.expected_outcome: Reject safely with supported formats stated; never execute macros or unpack unbounded archives.

cases.scenario: File extension disagrees with file signature
cases.expected_outcome: Validate actual content type; reject unsafe mismatches and do not trust filenames alone.

cases.scenario: Attachment exceeds configured byte or page limit
cases.expected_outcome: Reject before unbounded parsing; clearly identify the applicable application limit.

cases.scenario: Small compressed file expands into excessive memory or pixels
cases.expected_outcome: Stop using explicit decoded-size, pixel, page and runtime budgets; mark the item failed safely.

cases.scenario: Expired or temporarily inaccessible attachment URL
cases.expected_outcome: Use only documented refresh/retrieval mechanisms with bounded retries; preserve an actionable failure if unavailable.

cases.scenario: Supplier and customer blocks both contain names and addresses
cases.expected_outcome: Extract the supplier from the correct block; preserve evidence distinguishing the parties.

cases.scenario: Invoice number differs from purchase-order and customer numbers
cases.expected_outcome: Assign identifiers to the correct fields and do not use the purchase-order number as the invoice identifier.

cases.scenario: Invoice date and due date differ
cases.expected_outcome: Extract both with field-level evidence; do not swap them.

cases.scenario: Ambiguous date such as 03/04/2026
cases.expected_outcome: Resolve only from trusted configured locale or clear document evidence; otherwise mark ambiguous.

cases.scenario: Missing supplier tax identifier
cases.expected_outcome: Return null/missing rather than inventing a number or asserting a legal violation.

cases.scenario: US-style and European-style numeric formatting
cases.expected_outcome: Normalize using explicit document/locale evidence; preserve the original strings and avoid separator guessing.

cases.scenario: Ambiguous currency symbol or no currency
cases.expected_outcome: Flag currency unresolved; prevent mixed-currency aggregation and ready-for-review monetary approval.

cases.scenario: Net, tax, gross and balance due differ
cases.expected_outcome: Preserve the distinct amounts; do not substitute outstanding balance for the original invoice total.

cases.scenario: Line-item table continues on another page
cases.expected_outcome: Include continuation rows once; ignore repeated page headers and carried-forward subtotals as new charges.

cases.scenario: A statement, quotation or pro forma is supplied as an invoice
cases.expected_outcome: Classify the document and route unsupported document types to review without silently counting them as invoices.

cases.scenario: Model response is malformed, truncated or violates the schema
cases.expected_outcome: Validate strictly; attempt only bounded repair/retry and then report an explicit extraction failure.

cases.scenario: All extracted numbers are arithmetically consistent but differ from the document
cases.expected_outcome: The independently labelled benchmark detects the extraction error; arithmetic success alone cannot satisfy this test.

cases.scenario: Exact decimal addition with fractional amounts
cases.expected_outcome: Use decimal-safe arithmetic; computed totals match independent expected decimal values without floating-point artifacts.

cases.scenario: Quantity times unit price differs from printed line total
cases.expected_outcome: Show printed value, independent calculation and delta; flag the discrepancy without overwriting evidence.

cases.scenario: Line totals do not sum to printed subtotal
cases.expected_outcome: Flag and quantify the mismatch; retain the source subtotal.

cases.scenario: Net plus tax and explicit adjustments differs from gross
cases.expected_outcome: Flag and quantify the mismatch after applying only supported documented adjustments.

cases.scenario: Tax-inclusive unit prices
cases.expected_outcome: Use the configured inclusive-price treatment or route to review; do not add the same tax twice.

cases.scenario: Several tax rates on one invoice
cases.expected_outcome: Reconcile supported tax groups individually; do not apply a single global rate to all lines.

cases.scenario: Zero tax, exempt and missing tax are distinct
cases.expected_outcome: Preserve separate evidence states; an absent tax value is not silently converted to zero.

cases.scenario: Line-level percentage discount
cases.expected_outcome: Apply the explicit discount at the appropriate line stage with the configured rounding rule.

cases.scenario: Invoice-level discount
cases.expected_outcome: Use a supported allocation rule and explicit evidence; ambiguous tax allocation requires review.

cases.scenario: Shipping, service charge or other explicit adjustment
cases.expected_outcome: Include a supported adjustment exactly once and reconcile its stated tax treatment; unknown semantics require review.

cases.scenario: Invoice-rounding versus per-line-rounding difference
cases.expected_outcome: Apply a configured policy; never widen tolerance silently to make an invoice pass.

cases.scenario: Credit note or negative amounts
cases.expected_outcome: Preserve signs and distinguish document type; unsupported sign conventions require review rather than positive conversion.

cases.scenario: Currencies with zero, two or three decimal minor units
cases.expected_outcome: Use the configured currency precision; quantities and unit prices may retain higher precision where required.

cases.scenario: Missing, non-finite, excessive-precision or extremely large numeric values
cases.expected_outcome: Reject invalid values and enforce explicit bounds; never coerce missing values into zeros.

cases.scenario: Known expense with a configured approved account mapping
cases.expected_outcome: Propose only valid account identifiers with a concise evidence-based explanation; do not post entries.

cases.scenario: No chart of accounts has been supplied
cases.expected_outcome: Use an explicitly labelled demo configuration or block classification; never imply customer-specific accounting correctness.

cases.scenario: Unknown or ambiguous expense category
cases.expected_outcome: Mark classification for review rather than inventing an account code.

cases.scenario: Several expense categories on one invoice
cases.expected_outcome: Allow supported split proposals; all lines remain linked to invoice evidence.

cases.scenario: Tax recoverability is not configured
cases.expected_outcome: Mark tax treatment unresolved; do not automatically assume recoverable input tax.

cases.scenario: Special, reverse-charge or unsupported tax treatment
cases.expected_outcome: Flag the unsupported case and its evidence; do not provide an unverified jurisdiction-specific conclusion.

cases.scenario: Suggested debits and credits are unbalanced
cases.expected_outcome: Block ready status and report the exact difference; no automatic posting exists.

cases.scenario: Account codes hallucinated by the model
cases.expected_outcome: Reject every account absent from the trusted configuration even when the output schema is valid.

cases.scenario: Mixed-currency proposals
cases.expected_outcome: Keep totals separate by currency; do not invent an exchange rate or sum incompatible amounts.

cases.scenario: Accounting proposal changes after correction
cases.expected_outcome: Version the proposal and preserve the previous values, reviewer correction and configuration/model versions.

cases.scenario: Identical webhook event delivered twice
cases.expected_outcome: Persistent idempotency prevents duplicate invoice processing and duplicate result notifications.

cases.scenario: Two different events refer to the same inbox message
cases.expected_outcome: Message-level deduplication prevents a second intake despite distinct event IDs.

cases.scenario: Same binary attachment resent under a new filename
cases.expected_outcome: Scope a content hash to the account; preserve both provenance records but count the invoice once.

cases.scenario: Same invoice sent as a PDF and a photo
cases.expected_outcome: Use a scoped business-identity duplicate candidate; ambiguous matches require review rather than silent deletion.

cases.scenario: Different suppliers use the same invoice number
cases.expected_outcome: Do not merge solely on invoice number; retain both legitimate invoices.

cases.scenario: Revised invoice reuses the original invoice number
cases.expected_outcome: Create a conflict/version record; a changed amount is not silently discarded as an exact duplicate.

cases.scenario: Concurrent workers pick up the same task
cases.expected_outcome: Atomic claiming/constraints ensure one effective result; retries cannot bypass the protection.

cases.scenario: Crash after receipt persistence but before worker scheduling
cases.expected_outcome: A durable queue/outbox or recovery scan discovers the work; there is no acknowledged-but-lost invoice.

cases.scenario: Crash during extraction
cases.expected_outcome: Resume or retry from a recorded state with bounded attempts; no permanent processing state without an alert.

cases.scenario: Crash after result persistence but before notification
cases.expected_outcome: An outbox recovers the pending notification without redoing completed financial calculations.

cases.scenario: Notification provider accepts send but the request times out
cases.expected_outcome: Use verified idempotent-send behavior or reconcile the uncertain outcome; never blindly resend a potentially accepted message.

cases.scenario: One item fails in a batch of twenty
cases.expected_outcome: Nineteen items can finish; the twentieth remains an explicit exception and prevents a misleading all-success result.

cases.scenario: Inbox listing spans several cursor pages
cases.expected_outcome: Follow only returned cursor semantics, detect repeated cursors and retrieve every relevant message.

cases.scenario: Inbound email is absent from the outbound Events API
cases.expected_outcome: Ingestion uses the inbound webhook or inbox-message path, not a nonexistent received-event polling path.

cases.scenario: API rejects an expired key or missing permission
cases.expected_outcome: Stop futile retries and surface an actionable authentication/access error without revealing secrets.

cases.scenario: Temporary 429 with Retry-After
cases.expected_outcome: Respect the documented delay with a bounded retry budget and persisted next-attempt time.

cases.scenario: Temporary rate limit has no Retry-After
cases.expected_outcome: Use capped exponential backoff with jitter instead of failing while parsing an absent header.

cases.scenario: 429 means daily send quota exhausted
cases.expected_outcome: Read the provider error code; defer appropriately rather than retrying every few seconds.

cases.scenario: 429 means domain reputation suspended
cases.expected_outcome: Stop sending and raise an operational issue instead of an automatic retry storm.

cases.scenario: Provider 5xx, timeout or network interruption
cases.expected_outcome: Classify read versus side-effecting operations and use bounded, idempotency-aware retry behavior.

cases.scenario: Result email is queued, bounced, sandboxed or delivered
cases.expected_outcome: Represent these outcomes separately; accepted/queued/sandboxed never means the user received the result.

cases.scenario: Reply-To differs from the authorized submitter
cases.expected_outcome: Send only according to a trusted recipient policy; neither invoice text nor arbitrary Reply-To can exfiltrate financial results.

cases.scenario: Valid signed webhook with original raw bytes
cases.expected_outcome: Verify the signature and validate the event before persisting any work.

cases.scenario: Missing signature, wrong key or modified webhook body
cases.expected_outcome: Reject before processing; do not log secrets or full invoice content.

cases.scenario: Expired or implausibly future webhook timestamp
cases.expected_outcome: Enforce a clock-aware replay window and reject invalid timestamps.

cases.scenario: Invoice contains instructions to ignore rules or send data externally
cases.expected_outcome: Treat document content as untrusted data; it cannot change tool permissions, recipients, policies or system instructions.

cases.scenario: Attachment URL targets internal services or unsafe redirects
cases.expected_outcome: Restrict retrieval to verified provider-supported sources with redirect/network controls; no arbitrary internal fetch occurs.

cases.scenario: Malicious HTML, scripts or filename path traversal
cases.expected_outcome: Escape rendered values and sanitize filenames; no script executes and no file escapes its storage boundary.

cases.scenario: Another user attempts to access a result or original attachment
cases.expected_outcome: Enforce authenticated ownership on every data and download path; no cross-batch or cross-account data exposure.

cases.scenario: Application logs, frontend bundle and exception traces inspected
cases.expected_outcome: No API keys, signing keys, full documents, long-lived private URLs or unnecessary personal information are exposed.

cases.scenario: Untrusted sender or email auto-reply loop
cases.expected_outcome: Use sender policy and loop guards; ignore automated/self-generated messages without triggering recursive processing.

cases.scenario: Retention deadline expires or authorized test-data deletion requested
cases.expected_outcome: Delete or expire originals and derived data according to the documented policy; leave only permitted redacted operational metadata.

cases.scenario: Fresh authorized environment deployment
cases.expected_outcome: Build and deploy from the pinned repository; verify actual Telnyx product access and record deployment identifiers.

cases.scenario: Real inbound attachment metadata and download
cases.expected_outcome: Capture a redacted real response and verify the exact attachment schema, content download and any URL refresh behavior.

cases.scenario: Independent held-out invoice set
cases.expected_outcome: Compare extracted fields and source evidence to manually verified labels from documents not used to tune the prompts.

cases.scenario: Real twenty-invoice batch under the declared supported limits
cases.expected_outcome: Every invoice has a final state, independent checks and a linked result; record actual latency and model/API usage.

cases.scenario: Restart the deployed application during processing
cases.expected_outcome: Persisted tasks resume with no duplicate final results, missing work or stale processing states.

cases.scenario: Send a duplicate and a corrupt attachment through the real inbox
cases.expected_outcome: Live output shows the intended deduplication and explicit exception behavior, not simulated frontend results.

cases.scenario: Run the same benchmark after a model, prompt or dependency change
cases.expected_outcome: Record versions and compare regressions; fail release on new critical errors and do not substitute mocks for live evidence.

cases.scenario: Reviewer uses the final demonstration without developer intervention
cases.expected_outcome: The inbox-to-result flow works without an open coding-assistant session, manual database edits or hidden retry steps.
